entities.name: Vojislav Jovanović Marambo
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Vojislav M. Jovanović Marambo was a Serbian drama critic, playwright, historian, university professor, diplomat and research scholar. He first made a name for himself as a drama critic, playwright, and historian of literature with a particular emphasis on the study of folklore, then as a translator, journalist, bibliographer, archivist, diplomat, and above all a passionate collector of books and bibliophile. He is often ranked as one of the great playwrights in the tradition of European naturalism and a proponent of the kitchen sink drama, long before it became a trend in 1950.
